model_output.verdict: An experienced welder and fitter with inspection results and certifications that make the work easy to understand.
write_up: This is a strong welding resume! Your work moves from shop preparation at Great Lakes Mechanical to pipe welding and structural fitting, with the processes, materials and inspection results a recruiter needs to see.

The Riverfront Tower line is the standout: it names the job, the inspections and about 900 welds. Your certifications are easy to find below your experience, and the progression into training new hires comes through.
You don't need a major overhaul. Add how many people you train and what you did during plant shutdowns, if you can. The requirements and competition for each job will matter too.

cards.line: - Passed every third-party UT and visual inspection on the Riverfront Tower job (about 900 welds)
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as your model. It puts your inspection record alongside the job and the number of welds, so a recruiter can see what passed and where.

cards.line: - Train new hires on the shop's fit-up and tacking procedures
cards.cannot_tell: This shows that you train new hires, but not how many or how often. That would show how much of your work involves training.
cards.example: Train [number] new hires on the shop's fit-up and tacking procedures [how often]
cards.question: How many new hires do you train, and how often?

cards.line: - Worked nights and weekends on plant shutdowns
cards.cannot_tell: The schedule is clear, but a recruiter can't tell what work you did during the shutdowns. Name the work you performed there.
cards.example: Worked nights and weekends on plant shutdowns, [work performed]
cards.question: What work did you perform during the plant shutdowns?

fit.why: Your current Welder / Fitter role covers structural welding, fit-up, inspections and training.
fit.level: Experienced welder and fitter who trains new hires
fit.note: Your structural steel work and AWS certification point toward welding and fitting roles. Your earlier process piping work and ASME 6G certification also give a recruiter a reason to consider you for pipe welding.
